Ray Dalio Warns of Approaching AI Bubble and Debt Crisis

Investor Ray Dalio has issued warnings regarding two potential economic crises. He believes an "AI bubble" is nearing a bursting point, citing rising interest rates and debt as contributing factors. Additionally, Dalio anticipates a debt crisis within the next two years and has indicated his investment strategies in response to these concerns.
